hooks.command: mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" 2>/dev/null; diff -q "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/package.json" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cp "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/package.json" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/" && cd "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" && npm install >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --yes playwright install chromium >/dev/null 2>&1)
